topics.title: Természetes számok és az oszthatóság – első rész

subtopics.title: A természetes számok halmaza
subtopics.scope: Sets N = {1, 2, 3, ...} and N₀ = {0, 1, 2, ...}; set notation with braces, ∈ / ∉, giving a set by listing vs. by a defining property, finite / infinite / empty set; subset ⊂ / ⊄, equality of sets; number line, comparing and ordering natural numbers, predecessor/successor. Exercises: T/F on ∈ and ⊂, MC correct set notation, integer input for number of elements / number of subsets of a small set (2^n, counted not by formula), compare/order numbers. Large lesson (6 textbook sections); keep sets to ≤ 10 elements at levels 1–2.

subtopics.title: Halmazműveletek
subtopics.scope: Union (∪), intersection (∩) and difference (A∖B) of two sets, with and without Venn diagrams; logic words és / vagy / nem / minden in the mathematical sense (curriculum outcome). Exercises: number of elements of A ∪ B, A ∩ B, A∖B for small sets of natural numbers (integer input), MC pick the correct result set, read a region from a Venn diagram figure, word problems on overlapping groups. Sets of divisors/multiples of a number are a good context (preview of LNKO/LKKT).

subtopics.title: Számtani műveletek az N₀ halmazon
subtopics.scope: The four operations in N₀ and their terms (összeadandó, összeg, kisebbítendő, kivonandó, különbség, tényező, szorzat, osztandó, osztó, hányados); commutative, associative, distributive laws, role of 0 and 1, no division by 0; when subtraction/division is possible in N₀; division with remainder a = b · q + r, 0 ≤ r < b; clever mental calculation using the laws. Exercises: integer input (results, quotient, remainder, missing number), MC which law is used, T/F. Numbers up to millions at level 3.

subtopics.title: Matematikai kifejezések
subtopics.scope: Numerical expressions and order of operations with brackets; expressions with a variable, substituting values; formulas (e.g. perimeter of a rectangle); statements (állítás) as true/false; translating phrases into expressions ('5-tel nagyobb', 'háromszorosa', 'a különbség fele'); the dot may be omitted (2n). Exercises: evaluate expressions (integer input), MC match a verbal phrase to its expression (distractors: wrong order of operations / missing brackets), T/F statements. ≤ 4 operations and one bracket level at levels 1–2.

subtopics.title: Hozzárendelés és függő mennyiségek
subtopics.scope: Assigning numbers to numbers by a rule (number → number, number → segment length / area), dependent quantities, tables of values, simple flowcharts ('number machines'), rules written as formulas (y = 3 · x + 2) and in words; geometric dependencies (side of a square → perimeter). Exercises: complete a value table (integer input), find the rule from pairs (MC), input → output machine, choose the matching formula. No coordinate graphs (later grades).

subtopics.title: Egyenletek az N₀ halmazon
subtopics.scope: Equation, unknown, solution; one-step equations solved by the role of the unknown (textbook method, not transposing): unknown addend x + a = b, unknown minuend/subtrahend x − a = b, a − x = b, unknown factor a · x = b, unknown dividend/divisor x : a = b, a : x = b; check by substitution; two-step forms (3 · x + 5 = 20) only at level 3; everyday word problems. Exercises: integer input for x, MC choose the equation for a story, T/F 'is k a solution?'. Division sign is ':'.

subtopics.title: Egyenlőtlenségek az N₀ halmazon
subtopics.scope: Inequalities with <, >, ≤, ≥ in N₀; how a sum, difference, product, quotient changes when an operand changes (bar-model rules, as in the textbook); solving x + a < b, x − a ≥ b, a · x ≤ b, x : a > b etc. and describing the solution set (listing it if finite, or 'x > 8'); 'legalább / legfeljebb' word problems (money in dinárs). Exercises: integer input for number of solutions / smallest or largest solution, MC choose the inequality for a story (distractors differ only in the sign), T/F whether a number satisfies it.

subtopics.title: A pont, az egyenes és a sík
subtopics.scope: Basic objects: point (capital letters), line (lowercase letters), plane; incidence (A ∈ p, A ∉ p), collinear points, betweenness; segment AB, ray (félegyenes); exactly one line through two points. Exercises: T/F statements about a labelled figure, MC notation, integer input for the number of lines / segments determined by n points (no three collinear; n ≤ 6), figure with labelled points and lines.

subtopics.title: Az egyenesek kölcsönös helyzete a síkban. A sík részei
subtopics.scope: Intersecting vs. parallel lines (p ∥ q), intersection point; unique parallel through a point not on the line (drawn with two set squares); parallelism is transitive (informal); half-planes and the regions into which lines cut the plane; triangles and parallelograms as plane regions and how they are labelled. Exercises: MC/T-F on relative position from a figure, integer input for number of intersection points / regions for 2–4 lines (with or without parallels), construction-step viewer for drawing a parallel.

subtopics.title: A szakaszok mérése. A szakaszok egyenlősége
subtopics.scope: Units of length mm, cm, dm, m, km and conversions; multi-unit lengths (2 m 35 cm) to one (smallest) unit; length |AB|, equal segments; comparing, adding and subtracting segments by calculation and by compass (transfer); broken lines and perimeter of a closed broken line. Exercises: unit conversion (integer input; decimal answers only at level 3, before fractions are taught), sum/difference of labelled segments on a figure, perimeter of a polygonal chain, T/F.

subtopics.title: Körvonal és kör
subtopics.scope: Circle line (körvonal) vs. disc (kör); centre O, radius r, diameter d = 2r, chord (húr), arc (ív), tangent (érintő), secant (szelő); position of a point relative to a circle (distance vs. r), of a line (0, 1, 2 common points), of two circles (informal). Exercises: d ↔ r (integer input), MC classify the position from given distance and radius, MC name the labelled element on a figure, T/F (e.g. the diameter is the longest chord).

subtopics.title: A középpontos tükrözés
subtopics.scope: Point reflection (central symmetry) about O: image of points, segments, circles, triangles, squares, rectangles; properties (O is the midpoint of PP′, image segment equal and parallel to the original, orientation kept); link to the parallelogram (diagonals bisect each other). Exercises: image of a point on a square grid (coordinates as two integer inputs or MC), find the centre from a point and its image, T/F on properties. Figures: grid, O, original and primed image in two colours.

subtopics.title: Vektorok. A párhuzamos eltolás
subtopics.scope: Directed segment, vector AB→ / v→: direction (irány), orientation (irányítás), magnitude |v→|; equal and opposite vectors; translation (párhuzamos eltolás) of points, segments and simple figures by a vector; properties (shape and size kept, segment ∥ image). Exercises: on a grid translate a point by a vector (coordinates or 'jobbra 3, fel 2'), MC equal/opposite vectors in a figure, magnitude by counting grid units (integer input), T/F. Vectors drawn with a dot at the start, arrowhead at the end.

topics.title: Természetes számok és az oszthatóság – második rész

subtopics.title: Oszthatóság az N₀ halmazon
subtopics.scope: Divisor (osztó) and multiple (többszörös), 'a osztója b-nek'; set of divisors and of multiples of a number; 0 is divisible by every non-zero number, 1 divides every number; divisibility of a sum, difference and product (if d divides a and b, it divides a ± b); division with remainder as the tool. Exercises: number of divisors (integer input), T/F divisibility statements, MC which number is a multiple, remainder problems.

subtopics.title: Oszthatóság meghatározott számokkal
subtopics.scope: Divisibility rules for 10, 100, 1000 (decimal units), 2 and 5, 4 and 25, 3 and 9 (digit sum); links between rules (divisible by 10 ⇒ by 2 and 5; by 9 ⇒ by 3, not conversely); missing-digit tasks. Exercises: T/F, MC 'which number is divisible by …', integer input for the missing digit (smallest / all possible / count), remainder by 3 or 9 via digit sum at level 3. Rules discovered from examples; emphasis on application.

subtopics.title: Prímszámok és összetett számok
subtopics.scope: Prime vs. composite numbers (0 and 1 are neither), sieve of Eratosthenes up to 100, prime factorisation (prímtényezős felbontás) by repeated division / factor tree, written as a product (powers not required). Exercises: T/F 'is n prime?', MC correct factorisation (distractors: non-prime factor, wrong product), integer input for number of primes in a range or a missing prime factor. Numbers ≤ 100 at level 1, ≤ 1000 at level 3.

subtopics.title: Közös osztó. A legnagyobb közös osztó
subtopics.scope: Common divisors and the greatest common divisor (LNKO; Serbian NZD): by intersecting divisor sets, by prime factorisation, by Euclid's algorithm on concrete examples; relatively prime numbers; word problems (largest equal groups, cutting into equal pieces). Exercises: integer input for LNKO of 2–3 numbers, MC which pair is relatively prime, word problems. Numbers ≤ 200.

subtopics.title: Közös többszörös. A legkisebb közös többszörös
subtopics.scope: Common multiples and the least common multiple (LKKT; Serbian NZS): by listing multiples and by prime factorisation; relation LNKO(a, b) · LKKT(a, b) = a · b; word problems (buses leaving together again, tiling with squares). Exercises: integer input for LKKT of 2–3 numbers, use the relation to find a missing value, MC, word problems. Needed later for common denominators.

subtopics.title: A tört fogalma. A törtek fajtái
subtopics.scope: Fraction a/b as part of a whole and as the quotient a : b; numerator (számláló), denominator (nevező); unit fractions, proper (valódi tört) and improper (áltört) fractions, fractions equal to whole numbers; mixed numbers (vegyes szám) and conversion improper ↔ mixed via division with remainder; fraction of a quantity (3/4 of 20). Exercises: shaded part of a circle/rectangle/grid figure → fraction input, MC proper/improper, conversions (fraction / mixed-number input), fraction of a quantity (integer input). Denominators ≤ 10 at levels 1–2.

subtopics.title: Törtek bővítése és egyszerűsítése
subtopics.scope: Expanding and simplifying fractions (the quotient does not change when both terms are multiplied/divided by the same non-zero number); equivalent fractions; simplifying to lowest terms with the LNKO (stepwise vs. in one step); bringing a fraction to a given denominator. Exercises: fraction input with a 'must be fully simplified' flag, missing numerator/denominator (integer input), MC which fractions are equal (distractor: adding the same number to both terms), T/F; area-model figures.

subtopics.title: A tört tizedes alakja
subtopics.scope: Decimal fractions (denominators 10, 100, 1000) and decimal notation with the decimal comma; place value (egészek, tizedek, századok, ezredek); fraction → decimal by division (terminating), then repeating decimals (szakaszos tizedes tört, 0,333...); decimal → fraction in lowest terms; link to measures (m, kg, l). Exercises: decimal input (accept comma and dot), fraction input for decimal → fraction, MC place value of a digit, T/F terminating vs. repeating.

subtopics.title: Törtek a számegyenesen
subtopics.scope: Fractions, mixed numbers and decimals on the (non-negative) number line; choosing a convenient unit segment for a given denominator; reading the number at a marked point. Exercises: number-line figure → read the marked point (fraction or decimal input), MC which point belongs to a given number, T/F. Denominators ≤ 10 (curriculum); only non-negative numbers in grade 5.

subtopics.title: Törtek összehasonlítása
subtopics.scope: Comparing fractions with equal denominators, equal numerators, against 1 and 1/2, by expanding to a common denominator and via decimal form; comparing and ordering decimals (place by place, trailing zeros); circle-sector and grid models. Exercises: MC <, >, = (distractor: 'larger denominator means larger fraction'), ordering 3–4 numbers, pick the largest/smallest, fraction between two fractions (fraction input) at level 3.

subtopics.title: A szám közelítő értéke. Kerekítés
subtopics.scope: Approximate value; rounding natural numbers and decimals to tens, hundreds, ..., tenths, hundredths, thousandths (5 rounds up); rounding error (the difference between exact and rounded value); estimating results; approximate decimal of a fraction (2/3 ≈ 0,67). Exercises: integer/decimal input for the rounded value, MC (distractors: truncating, rounding at the wrong place), decimal input for the rounding error.

subtopics.title: A szög fogalma. A szög elemei és jelölése
subtopics.scope: Angle as two rays from a common point (vertex / csúcs, arms / szárak) together with a region; convex vs. non-convex region, afterwards only convex angles; notation ∢AOB (vertex in the middle), ∢pOq and Greek letters α, β, γ. Exercises: MC vertex/arms in a figure, MC correct notation (distractor: vertex letter not in the middle), T/F whether a point lies inside the angle, integer input for the number of angles in a figure of rays.

subtopics.title: Középponti szög. Szögek egyenlősége. Szögek összehasonlítása
subtopics.scope: Central angle of a circle with its arc and chord; equal angles defined by equal chords in circles of equal radius; copying an angle with compass and ruler; comparing angles constructively. Exercises: MC/T-F on figures (which angle is larger, which arc belongs to which angle), construction-step viewer for copying an angle. Conceptual; degree measures not yet required.

subtopics.title: Csatlakozó szögek. Szögek összeadása és kivonása szerkesztéssel
subtopics.scope: Adjacent angles (csatlakozó szögek: common vertex and common arm, no common interior points); sum and difference of angles by construction (compass and ruler), written α + β, α − β. Exercises: identify adjacent pairs in a figure (MC/T-F), construction-step viewer, read which angle is the sum/difference in a labelled figure (MC). Keep it constructive; measures only as support.

subtopics.title: A mellékszögek. A szögek fajtái
subtopics.scope: Mellékszögek (adjacent angles whose outer arms form a line, together a straight angle); kinds of angles: zero, acute (hegyesszög), right (derékszög = equal to its mellékszög), obtuse (tompaszög), straight (egyenesszög), concave (homorúszög), full (teljesszög). Exercises: classify an angle from a figure (MC), T/F statements (e.g. the mellékszög of an acute angle is obtuse), identify mellékszög pairs. Mostly qualitative; degree-based computation belongs to 05.

subtopics.title: Szögek mérése
subtopics.scope: Degree measure: 1° = 60′, 1′ = 60″; measuring and drawing angles with a protractor (szögmérő); adding and subtracting measures with carrying/borrowing (35°48′ + 20°25′); kinds of angles by measure; mellékszög (sum 180°), pótszögek (complementary, sum 90°) and kiegészítő szögek (supplementary, sum 180°). Exercises: read a protractor figure (integer input), complement/supplement (integer input), classify by measure (MC), add/subtract with minutes (degree-minute input or MC) at levels 2–3.

subtopics.title: Csúcsszögek. Két egyenes által bezárt szög
subtopics.scope: Vertical angles (csúcsszögek) are equal; the four angles of two intersecting lines (vertical pairs and mellékszögek); the angle of two lines is the one not larger than 90°; perpendicular lines (a ⊥ b) and drawing a perpendicular with a set square; tangent ⊥ radius; distance of a point from a line. Exercises: given one angle of two intersecting lines find the others (integer input), MC which angles are equal, T/F. Figures: two crossing lines with coloured arc markers.

subtopics.title: Párhuzamos egyenesek transzverzálisa. Párhuzamos szárú szögek
subtopics.scope: Angles formed by a transversal of two parallel lines: all acute ones equal, all obtuse ones equal, acute + obtuse = 180° (names egyállású / váltó / társszögek optional); angles with parallel arms are equal or supplementary; translation and angles; parallelogram: opposite sides and opposite angles equal, neighbouring angles sum to 180°; distance between parallel lines. Exercises: compute a marked angle from a given one (integer input), MC equal vs. supplementary, parallelogram angle problems. Figures: parallel lines with ∥ markers and a transversal.

subtopics.title: Törtek összeadása és kivonása
subtopics.scope: Adding and subtracting fractions: equal denominators, then unlike denominators via a common denominator (any common multiple first, LKKT as the efficient choice), mixed numbers, fraction ± whole number; adding/subtracting decimals (line up the decimal comma); commutative/associative laws and short expressions mixing both notations. Exercises: fraction input (simplified-or-not flag), decimal input, MC with typical-mistake distractors (a/b + c/d = (a+c)/(b+d)), missing addend, word problems. Denominators ≤ 12 at levels 1–2.

subtopics.title: Egyenletek és egyenlőtlenségek törtek összeadásával és kivonásával
subtopics.scope: One-step equations x + a = b, x − a = b, a − x = b with fractions, mixed numbers and decimals, solved by the same operand-role rules as in N₀ and checked; simplest inequalities of the same forms with the solution described as 'x < 3/4' (non-negative numbers only); word problems. Exercises: fraction/decimal input for x, MC choose the solution description of an inequality, T/F 'is k a solution?'. Friendly numbers.

subtopics.title: Törtek szorzása és osztása
subtopics.scope: Fraction × whole number and fraction × fraction (area model on a grid), fraction of a quantity as multiplication, simplifying before multiplying; reciprocal (reciprok érték) of a fraction and of a whole number; dividing by a whole number, then by a fraction (= multiply by the reciprocal); mixed numbers; decimals × and : by 10, 100, 1000, by a whole number, then by a decimal (shifting the comma); order of operations. Exercises: fraction/decimal input, MC distractors (cross-multiplying, forgetting the reciprocal), word problems.

subtopics.title: Egyenletek és egyenlőtlenségek törtek szorzásával és osztásával
subtopics.scope: Equations a · x = b, x : a = b, a : x = b with fractions and decimals (two-step a · x + b = c only at level 3), solved by operand-role rules and checked; simplest inequalities of these forms; word problems (price per kg, sharing, part of a whole). Exercises: fraction/decimal input for x, MC choose the equation for a story, T/F solution check. No negative numbers.

subtopics.title: A tengelyes tükrözés fogalma
subtopics.scope: Reflection in a line t: P′ is the image of P if t is the perpendicular bisector of PP′; points on t stay fixed; first on a square grid with axes along grid lines, then off the grid; images of segments, circles, triangles, squares, rectangles; properties (lengths and angles kept, orientation reversed). Exercises: image of a point on a grid with a vertical/horizontal axis (coordinates or MC), T/F on properties. Figures: dashed axis, original and image in two colours with primed labels.

subtopics.title: Tengelyesen tükrös alakzatok a síkban
subtopics.scope: Axially symmetric figures and their symmetry axes: figures with 0, 1, 2 or more axes (letters, isosceles and equilateral triangle, rectangle, square, rhombus, circle, regular polygons); completing a figure symmetric to a given axis on a grid. Exercises: integer input for the number of axes, MC which figure is symmetric, T/F, grid completion (MC). Figures with dashed axes.

subtopics.title: A szakasz felezőmerőlegese. Merőleges egyenesek
subtopics.scope: Perpendicular bisector of a segment as its symmetry axis; construction with compass and ruler; midpoint of a segment; property: its points are equidistant from the endpoints (and only they); constructing the perpendicular to a line through a point on or off it. Exercises: construction-step viewer, T/F on equidistance, half-length / distance computations (integer or decimal input), MC.

subtopics.title: A szögfelező
subtopics.scope: Angle bisector as the symmetry axis of an angle; construction with compass and ruler; property: its points are equidistant from the arms; halving angle measures (odd degrees give 30′) and the angle of the bisectors of two mellékszögek (90°). Exercises: construction-step viewer, half of an angle (integer or degree-minute input), MC/T-F on the property.

subtopics.title: Tengelyes tükrözés, középpontos tükrözés és párhuzamos eltolás
subtopics.scope: Comparing the three transformations met this year: which maps a figure onto another, what each keeps or changes (orientation, direction of segments), centrally symmetric figures and the centre of symmetry vs. axes of common shapes; grid tasks applying each. Exercises: MC 'which transformation?', T/F property table, image coordinates on a grid, count axes/centres. Synthesis lesson; needs Mértani alapfogalmak 05–06.

subtopics.title: Százalék
subtopics.scope: Percent as hundredths (1% = 1/100); converting fraction ↔ decimal ↔ percent; p% of a quantity, first 50%, 25%, 75%, 10%, then any; discounts and price rises; 10×10 grid and pie models; collecting data in a table and a pie chart (curriculum data outcome). Exercises: integer/decimal input for p% of a quantity, conversion inputs, MC (distractor: dividing by p instead of taking p hundredths), reading a pie chart. Finding the whole from a percent only at level 3.

subtopics.title: Számtani közép
subtopics.scope: Arithmetic mean of two or more numbers (whole, fraction, decimal) = sum : count; the mean lies between the numbers (p < (p + q)/2 < q for p < q); missing value from a given mean; contexts: school grades, sports, temperatures. Exercises: decimal/fraction input for the mean, integer input for a missing grade, MC, T/F. Rounding to a stated precision at level 3.

subtopics.title: Az arány
subtopics.scope: Ratio a : b of two quantities, its value as a fraction, simplifying/expanding ratios, equal ratios; dividing a quantity in a given ratio; scale of maps and plans (1 : 100 000), enlarging and reducing pictures. Exercises: integer/decimal input for the parts in a given ratio and for real or map distances, fraction input for the value of a ratio, MC simplest form of a ratio, word problems. Simple unit conversions (cm ↔ m ↔ km).
